title: He Poisoned His Wife to Get With His Stepdaughter
description:
An Indiana woman believed she was being poisoned after being hospitalized multiple times. Each time she thought something was suspicious, there was a common factor — her husband and her beverages. She finally called the local Sheriff's Office and told deputies she thought her husband was spiking her drinks. Her husband, Alfred Ruf, not only confessed but also explained his disturbing reasonings behind the criminal acts. Find out what really happened on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
